sources.title: Demande Visa | E-CONSULAT
sources.publisher: Ministère des Affaires Étrangères, de la Migration et des Tunisiens à l'Étranger
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Tunisian MFA E-Consulat page sets advance-consular filing and a minimum 20-day process for an unnamed visa-subject cohort, with a current page footer. It does not name nationalities or publish a residual rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les personnes de nationalités soumises à la procédure de visa doivent prendre contact avec les Consulats de Tunisie.

sources.title: Les visas électroniques pour les étrangers au centre d'un conseil ministériel restreint
sources.publisher: Présidence du Gouvernement de la République Tunisienne
sources.officialityEvidence: Live official Presidency page was published 23 May 2024 and remains served by the up-to-date Government portal. Its language describes a platform to be designed and activated, not an operational eVisa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois mis en place, ce système facilitera l’obtention de visas.

sources.title: Publication de résultat d’un appel d’offres: Plateforme de Visa Electronique E-Visa
sources.publisher: Ministère des Technologies de la Communication
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Ministry procurement-result PDF identifies the eVisa platform tender and declares the result unsuccessful; it does not create an electronic issuance channel.

unresolved.reason: Current Tunisian primary material has no operative nationality schedule or explicit residual rule. E-Consulat refers only to an unnamed visa-subject cohort and residence-based consular filing; the Presidency's eVisa item is future-tense and the 2025 platform tender was unsuccessful. Group-tour, residence, invitation and special-document arrangements cannot produce a passport-wide baseline.
